channel.title: Game Night on Chasing Dings!
channel.description: Recent content in Game Night on Chasing Dings!

item.title: Frosthaven Scenario #16: Derelict Elevator
item.description: We’re back! And it’s more machines this time as we descend the Elevator of Dooooooom.

item.title: Frosthaven Scenario 34: Top of the Spire
item.description: We thought it would be a quick scenario. Kill one mob, loot and leave. That’s not the way it ended up.

item.title: Captain Sonar: Real Time.
item.description: We’d played Captain Sonar turn-by-turn, but how would we fare when everyone moved at the same time?

item.title: Frosthaven Scenario #23: Spire Basement
item.description: Our exploration of the ancient spire and its mysterious red beam of blood magic continues…

item.title: Captain Sonar: The First Mission
item.description: It’s family vs family in a tense hunt beneath the waves.

item.title: Frosthaven Scenario #15: Ancient Spire
item.description: After I don’t know how long, we finally meet the Machine Empire and retire the last of our starting crew.

item.title: Frosthaven #8 -- Crystal Trench
item.description: A mostly new crew tries to find its footing in a race against time as they had toward the Land of the Machines.

item.title: DCC: Sailors on a Starless Sea, Part 2
item.description: Will a hodgepodge collection of level 0 villagers be able to defeat an avatar of the Chaos Lord?

item.title: DCC: Sailors on a Starless Sea, Part 1
item.description: I finally had my chance to run a Dungeon Crawl Classics module! I learned a lot about DCC, and so did the players…

item.title: HeroQuest First Light: The Might of the Synchroform
item.description: For the final First Light campaign quest, Qwindrak is going to throw everything he has at us, one last time.
